name: AI-SRO
_comment_key: Pins the extension id. Chrome derives an unpacked extension's id from the absolute path it was loaded from, so it differed per machine and per checkout -- which meant the console's allowed origins and the API's CORS list could not be defaulted, and every developer configured them by hand. With a key the id is onfmljaebeipeiinflhgdochbcjeoehl everywhere. The matching private key is not kept: it would only be needed to sign a .crx, and the Web Store issues its own.
description: Watches how work is done, and does it back.
